verdict.line: You lose if you trade into an up Infernal Chains before 6; you win if you punish it on cooldown and outlast him past level 10.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's W (Infernal Chains) is a 20/18/16/14/12s all-in trigger that drags Volibear in for a fight Volibear can't dictate the start of, and his passive Deathbringer Stance plus E (Umbral Dash) sustain let him win extended trades even when poked. Volibear's counter is patience: W (Frenzied Maul)'s double-cast heal and E (Sky Splitter)'s shield only pay off once Aatrox's chains are down, which matches the 49.8% head-to-head over 2420 games — close, but tilted toward Aatrox whenever he engages on his terms.

theirWindow.when: Chains up and you're at 825+ range
theirWindow.what: He can land the smash and drag you to center for a second hit, then chain Q stacks and E dash-heal into a kill window. Don't walk up to trade minions while this is live — hold cs with Q (Thundering Smash) range only.

yourWindow.when: Chains just whiffed or on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk in and double-cast W (Frenzied Maul) for the mark-and-heal, backed by Q (Thundering Smash)'s stun if he tries to E (Umbral Dash) away. This is your only safe trade window before his passive resets.

powerCurve.note: Q auto-reset poke chips you before Bramble Vest
Chains threat plus World Ender at 6
W double-cast heal online, trades stabilize

Full build tankiness wins extended fights

start.why: The 70.4% pick rate start — the early sustain and cooldown-adjacent stats keep you in lane through Aatrox's Q poke phase without needing to back before Bramble Vest-tier armor is relevant.

boots.why: Cuts down the physical damage from his Q auto-resets and E dash-ins during extended trades, which matters more here than the alternative Ionian Boots given how often he's the one initiating.

core.why: Feeds the cooldown haste that lets W (Frenzied Maul) and E (Sky Splitter) come back up faster to answer his Chains cycle.
Attack speed and crit convert W's on-hit procs into real trade damage once you're inside his chains threat range.
Amplifies your W double-cast heal to directly contest his Deathbringer Stance plus Umbral Dash sustain race.

situational.when: aatrox is out-healing your trades through deathbringer stance and umbral dash
you're ahead and want to close out the lane fast rather than scale into teamfights
you want more poke and wave clear to punish his long q and w cooldowns from range

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping attack speed rewards you for staying in extended trades once his Chains is down, which is exactly the window you're trying to win with W procs.

summoners.why: The 79.2%-pick, 49.5% WR standard — Ignite punishes his all-in windows off Chains and cuts into the healing he gets from his passive and E.

playing.title: Track his Infernal Chains cooldown
playing.detail: It's a 20/18/16/14/12s skillshot that drags you to center if you don't clear the zone fast. Only commit to trades when you've seen it used or whiff.

playing.title: Hold range before level 6
playing.detail: His Q auto-resets chip you down for free at close range. Last-hit with Q (Thundering Smash)'s 300-range dash-stun instead of standing in melee.

playing.title: Double-cast W on cooldown windows
playing.detail: W (Frenzied Maul)'s second cast heals you — use it every time his Chains is down to win the sustain race instead of trading evenly.

playing.title: Use E to contest at range
playing.detail: Sky Splitter's 1200 range lets you slow and shield through poke exchanges without entering his Chains threat radius.

playing.title: Respect level 6 World Ender
playing.detail: His ultimate boosts AD, healing, and move speed and extends on a takedown — don't commit to a long fight right as he hits 6 unless you have a clear HP lead.

playing.title: Save your stun for his dash
playing.detail: Q (Thundering Smash) can punish Umbral Dash's short 9-5s cooldown reposition — stun him out of an escape rather than burning it to initiate.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reasoning — why these windows exist — is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Maintain your distance from Aatrox’s (Q) - (E). Use [E] to contest lane. Purchase Bramble Vest and use your skills whenever they come off cooldown to fight him.
